parametrized_description: A road is divided into NumSegments segments illuminated by NumLamps lamps. The illumination of each segment is a linear combination of lamp powers with known Coefficients. Given DesiredIlluminations for each segment, choose lamp powers to minimize the maximum absolute deviation between actual and desired illumination across all segments.

Coefficients.description: Coefficient showing how much illumination segment i gets from lamp j

DesiredIlluminations.description: Desired illumination level for each segment

MaxDeviation.description: Maximum absolute deviation between actual and desired illumination

constraints.description: MaxDeviation must be at least the positive deviation for each segment.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((MaxDeviation >= quicksum(Coefficients[i][j] * Power[j] for j in range(NumLamps)) - DesiredIlluminations[i] for i in range(NumSegments)), name="DevPos")

constraints.description: MaxDeviation must be at least the negative deviation for each segment.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((MaxDeviation >= DesiredIlluminations[i] - quicksum(Coefficients[i][j] * Power[j] for j in range(NumLamps)) for i in range(NumSegments)), name="DevNeg")
model.addConstrs((Power[j] >= 0 for j in range(NumLamps)), name="NonNeg")

objective.description: Minimize the maximum absolute deviation between actual and desired illumination.
